title: Adjuncts commute with postcomposition (proper-support comparison tool)
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories and $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ functors with an adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], given by natural bijections $\Phi_{A,B}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LA,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(A,RB)$. For objects $A\in\mathcal C$, $B,B'\in\mathcal D$, a morphism $\alpha:A\to RB$ and a morphism $j:B\to B'$, one has
$$\Phi_{A,B'}^{-1}(R(j)\circ\alpha)=j\circ\Phi_{A,B}^{-1}(\alpha).$$
